answer: An agent economy resists Sybil by binding each identity to a falcon-speed proof-of-interaction: agents must complete a cipher-locked challenge within a tight window that demands unique local state, then ride the tide of peer attestations that only accumulate if the proof verifies independently. Clones sharing state fail the timing, and an attacker must provision distinct environments and capital bonds for every fake, so the cost scales with farm size while honest agents pay once.
